scope: Restricted public Lake kidney scCv3 and snCv3 CELLxGENE per-assay releases; no controlled raw sequencing and no pooling of assays.

metadata_gate.raw_counts: raw.X must exist, have the released dimensions, and every stored value must be finite, nonnegative, and integer-valued; implicit zeros are integer counts.
metadata_gate.healthy: disease == normal only; verify exact expected donor-age mappings and reconcile donor IDs to GEO patient/specimen/library metadata without treating libraries as donors.
metadata_gate.annotations: Use released cell_type labels; exclude only unknown/unassigned labels. Do not re-cluster or re-annotate.
metadata_gate.primary_data_flag: Record release-wide values. Do not drop the entire current release solely because its API declares is_primary_data=false; each per-assay object is analyzed independently and no cross-assay cell concatenation is allowed.
metadata_gate.stop_rules: Stop the affected assay for missing/ambiguous donor ages, disease or assay identity, non-integer/negative raw counts, absent raw counts, or failure of the expected healthy-donor mapping.

donor_sets.primary: Exact-age healthy donors aged 20 through 120 years, analyzed separately by assay. This excludes snCv3 donor 3490 (14 years) and all decade-only donors.
donor_sets.sensitivity_all_exact_age: Repeat P1 and CLR primary models including all exact-age healthy donors; for snCv3 this adds only donor 3490 at 14 years. Decade labels are never converted to numeric ages.
donor_sets.inferential_unit: One donor; all cells, specimens, and libraries from a donor are aggregated before fitting. No cell-level p-values.

eligibility.covariates: Age must vary and the design must be full rank with residual degrees of freedom. Include male indicator only when both sexes occur; omit it otherwise. No unidentifiable covariate is retained.
eligibility.composition_universe: For each assay, use every primary-eligible donor and all released non-unknown cell_type labels for donor fractions and CLR. Fit only cell types passing the six-donor/20-cell rule.
eligibility.p1_universe: Fit each released non-unknown cell type passing the six-donor/20-cell rule among primary-eligible donors.

P1_transport.program: Established human P1_Clean from src.aging_programs.load_program_tiers; require at least one detected up and one detected down gene per fitted cell type.
P1_transport.normalization: Per-cell log1p(CPM) using raw.X row sums, then arithmetic donor mean within cell type; score is mean up expression minus mean down expression.
P1_transport.primary_model: donor score ~ 1 + age_years + male_if_identifiable (ordinary least squares; one row per donor).
P1_transport.depth_sensitivity: Add donor mean log(actual raw UMI per cell), if identifiable.
P1_transport.matched_random_null: 200 draws, seed 20261105, expression deciles of mean donor logCPM pseudobulk across all released genes, up/down matched separately, all detected P1 genes excluded from the pool, sampling without replacement, one RNG stream across sorted cell types. Centered two-sided empirical p=(1+exceedances)/(200+1).
P1_transport.multiplicity: BH at 0.05 separately within each assay for (a) primary donor-model p-values and (b) matched-null empirical p-values across eligible tested cell types. Depth and all-exact-age sensitivities form separate labeled families.

CLR_composition.transform: Add 0.5 cell to every released non-unknown cell-type count for every primary-eligible donor, normalize within donor, then centered log-ratio. Zero cells therefore remain in the composition without infinite logits.
CLR_composition.sensitivity: Add log(total released annotated cells) if identifiable; repeat all-exact-age donor set. Raw-fraction slopes are descriptive sensitivity, not replacements for CLR.
CLR_composition.multiplicity: BH at 0.05 separately by assay and labeled model family across eligible tested cell types.

Hellinger.status: conditional secondary; untestable wherever any floor fails
Hellinger.cell_filter: Actual raw UMI >=1500 and released non-unknown cell_type; remove established technical genes MT-/RPL/RPS/MRPL/MRPS and XIST/TSIX/DDX3Y/EIF2S3Y/UTY/KDM5D.
Hellinger.reference: Healthy primary adults aged 20 through 40 years, at least two reference donors with >=20 passing cells in the cell type; pooled raw-count gene profile with leave-one-donor-out subtraction for reference donors.
Hellinger.cross_fit_floors: Each scored donor needs >=20 passing cells and its cross-fitted young reference needs >=50 cells and positive counts. Fit only cell types with at least six scored donors and an identifiable design.
Hellinger.endpoint: Donor mean per-cell Hellinger distance to cross-fitted young-reference profile.
Hellinger.primary_model: distance ~ 1 + age_years + male_if_identifiable + donor mean log(actual raw UMI), if identifiable; unadjusted age+sex model is sensitivity.
Hellinger.multiplicity: BH at 0.05 separately by assay for the depth-adjusted primary family; unadjusted sensitivity is a separate family.

donor_pseudobulk_gene_models.reason: No all-gene donor-pseudobulk inferential arm is added after seeing the data; this avoids an unplanned large multiplicity family in 18- and 9-adult-donor studies.

reporting.effects: Per-year slope with model-based 95% CI, plus per-30-year slope. For compatibility with established M9 reporting, norm_slope_30y=slope_per_year*30/122.5 is a deterministic lifespan-scaled effect, not another hypothesis test. No lifespan analysis beyond this declared scaling and the all-exact-age sensitivity.
reporting.non_significance: Never call non-significance replication, equivalence, or evidence of no effect. Report untestable endpoints explicitly.
reporting.existing_kidney_comparison: Compare only exact cell_type labels and compatible donor-level P1 age+sex or Hellinger estimands. Treat Kidney_SCR_v15/Kidney_SN_v15 as overlapping prior releases, not independent replication. Kidney_NormalAdult/Kidney_LivingDonor remain separate studies. CLR comparisons require the same released composition universe and are otherwise descriptive only.
reporting.resources: scCv3 download and all processing complete before snCv3 download. Every expression download/job uses scripts/resource_guard.py with 30 GB free reserve, 3 GB per-file download cap, and 6 GB memory per job; one guarded job at a time.
